title: Boundary Values
prompt:
**Problem.** Line 1: n q. Then q lines: l r v (add v on [l, r]).
Print the final array, one value per line.

**Constraints:** 1 ≤ n, q ≤ 200000; |v| ≤ 10.

The W reads r before l — fatal on asymmetric ops.

tests.name: asymmetric
tests.hint: Op (1,2,+5) then (2,4,+3): [5,8,3,3]. The reversed-l/r W misorders the second op.

tests.name: single asymmetric op
tests.hint: One full-range op; the reversed W reads l=3, r=1 and produces [0,0,7].
